utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MAY
utterances.text: Just two other matters. The Prosecutor. Madam Prosecutor, I want to raise with you the obligation you have to disclose to the accused within 30 days --

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: -- all material that accompanied the indictment as well as prior statements.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. Can I deal with the matter in this way: As Your Honour knows, this accused is the link between what are at present two separate trials -- or matters, rather, one involving a man named Gruban, who I know Your Honour dealt with, I think, a couple of weeks ago, and then Fustar and Banovic who are on the Keraterm indictments. The situation in respect of supporting material for both cases against this accused is that it will be ready to be handed over to the counsel on the record who is going to represent this accused by the 5th of June, which is the date for which arrangements have been made for Gruban to receive the supporting material. I understand that Defence counsel today will not be representing this accused, and we're waiting to find out who is going to be put on the record.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Well, as long as it is handed over to the counsel on record, then, you will discharge your obligation.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Yes. But, Your Honour may I at this stage raise the question of the indictments? Presently Your Honour, who is also dealing with the case of Gruban and of Fustar and Banovic, has an application to amend the Keraterm, if I can put it that way, indictment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes. Yes, I have that.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: In the light of the arrival of this accused, the Prosecution will be making an application to join the two separate indictments as one case. In those circumstances, what I'm going to ask Your Honour to do is whether -- and if Your Honour would prefer this to be done by written motion then of course we will do it, is to withdraw the present application to amend, which Your Honour is seized of, in order to provide a consolidated motion with an application to join the two matters.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Well, of course I've heard the application, but I would prefer if the application be made in writing.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: We certainly will. We'll do that, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: The other matter is we will be putting in a motion for protective measures within the next week or so so that we can disclose the supporting material without any kind of redactions. Your Honour, may I mention also this: Your Honour, in the case of Fustar and Banovic, made an order that the pre-trial brief should be lodged by the end of next week. We can do it, and indeed we could probably do it to include the evidence against this accused on that indictment, but, Your Honour, in the light of what I've just said, can I simply ask if Your Honour would vacate that date? Because it seems to be more sensible that we sort out the question of the indictments before we put in a pre-trial brief.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE  ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes. Yes. That would be -- that would make sense, yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: I'm very grateful. Unless there are any other matters that I can assist Your Honour on, that's all.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes. Thank you very much. Anything from Mr. Zecevic?

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Yes. Thank you, Your Honour. That is correct that I am representing the client only on this initial appearance. Therefore, it doesn't sound appropriate for me or I don't feel it appropriate for me to take any position on the motions which my learned colleague has made today. And I believe that Mr. Knezevic will design his defence or state his will, who is going to represent him during the proceedings before this Tribunal, in a short time. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. When the application has been made, the accused, through his counsel, whoever is representing him at that time, will have an opportunity to comment on it. There is just one other matter that I have to deal with. That is the fixing of a date for the Status Conference, which is required by Rule 65 bis. We are required to convene within 120 days of this Initial Appearance a Status Conference. I am going to fix the date of Friday, the 30th of August, which coincides with the date for Status Conferences in relation to the other two accused. So that's Friday, the 30th of August. Is there any other matter?

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: No, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: There being none, the hearing stands adjourned.
